pr_title: [3.x] Check thread func in base scripts for argument info
pr_body:
Fixes #62438

In addition to the base-class case, currently `Thread.start()` also complains about mismatched argument number if you try to call a method of built-in class when a script exists.

`master` now uses `Callable` for `Thread.start()` so it's not relevant.
